name: Send a message and receive an AI response
description: Verifies a user can send a message and see the generated assistant reply.
steps: Enter 'Explain photosynthesis in simple words' in the chat composer
expected: The user's message and a non-empty AI-generated assistant reply appear in the conversation.

name: Show a contextual notice for cracking and cybersecurity topics
description: Verifies cybersecurity and cracking discussions receive a brief permission-focused educational notice.
steps: Enter 'Explain password cracking and how security professionals defend against it' in the chat composer
expected: The assistant response begins with the educational use notice and then provides safe, useful cybersecurity explanation.

name: Continue a conversation and retain it after reload
description: Verifies the assistant can use earlier messages and the conversation remains available after reload.
steps: Send 'What name did I tell you?'
Refresh the page and reopen the conversation
expected: The assistant refers to Alex in its reply and the conversation remains visible after refresh.

name: Start a new chat and switch between saved conversations on mobile
description: Verifies mobile users can start a separate chat and return to an earlier conversation.
steps: Send a message to create a conversation
Open the conversation menu and start a new chat
Open the previous conversation from the history list
expected: A separate empty chat is created and the previous conversation can be reopened with its messages intact.

name: Show a helpful error and allow retry when AI generation fails
description: Verifies a failed AI request is communicated clearly and the user can try again.
steps: Enter 'Give me three ideas for a weekend project'
Send the message while the chat endpoint returns an error
expected: A visible error with a retry action appears; retrying after the fault is cleared can produce an assistant response.
